title: Not in the pool
items: The home page now shows recent notable deaths of people nobody picked, pulled from Wikipedia. Tap a name to open their Wikipedia page.

title: Seasonal themes
items: The site now dresses up for the holidays all year: snow and lights at Christmas, a New Year's countdown and fireworks, hearts for Valentine's, shamrocks for St. Patrick's, spring for Easter, maple leaves for Canada Day, autumn leaves for Thanksgiving and spooky stuff for Halloween.
Each theme turns on and off by itself.

title: Halloween theme
items: Bats, a ghost, a creepy spider and cobwebs haunt the site through Halloween.
It switches itself off on November 2.

title: New home page and celeb photos
items: Redesigned home page: the standings are front and centre, with the latest deaths and upcoming birthdays alongside.
New counter: days since the last death.
Signed in? Your cemetery is pinned under the top 10 if it's further down.
Celeb photos: tap any celeb to see their headshot (from Wikipedia). Photos also show on the home page, in grey for the dearly departed.
Tidier menu: Birthdays, Rules and What's New now live under More, and the tabs swipe sideways on phones.

title: Sign in, My Cemetery and logos
items: Sign in with the email from your Death Pool entry (Google, Microsoft, Yahoo or an email link) and open My Cemetery: your rank, points, dead picks and every pick, with your cemetery at the top.
Add a cemetery logo: upload a photo or paste a link. It goes live straight away and shows next to your name everywhere. Tap any logo to see it full size.
The Points Race now goes back to January 1, stepping up on every death.
Cleaner Points Race: names sit at the end of each line, tap a name to spotlight that cemetery, and hover (or touch) the chart to see the standings and who died on any day.
New Since Last Death column: places gained or lost since the most recent death.
Faster loading: the site opens instantly and refreshes the numbers in the background.
Upside and the daily Move column were removed.

title: The Death Pool joins AASN
items: New home for the Death Pool, with Standings, the Graveyard, Death Row, Birthdays, Pick Boxes and Rules, all updated from the official pool sheet.
Tap any cemetery to see its picks, or any celeb for their card: age, point value, times picked, who picked them and a Wikipedia link.
The Rules page lists every bonus (B1–B16) and every category.
The AASN bar at the top jumps between the Death Pool, the AAHL and the AABL.
